overall: The AG found Waltham Girls Softball, Inc. is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law, so the alleged unnoticed election could not violate it; the matter was closed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged an unnoticed October 2014 meeting at which a softball association held an illegal election; the AG first asked whether the association is a public body.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that WGS is not a public body subject to the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.
